dog.description_text:
My foster writes: Sky is genuinely the sweetest little lady. She gets SO excited when we come home. Full-body wiggles, tail going, running right up to greet us like we've been gone for days.
She's also an absolute snuggle bug. If you pat the seat next to you, she'll hop right up, curl into you, rest her paws on you, and put her head in your lap. She really latches onto her people and just wants to be near you.
At home, she's incredibly easygoing. She'll happily snooze while you work, follow you from room to room to keep you company, and settle right back down. She doesn't bark inside, doesn't chew things she shouldn't, and has been such a polite little lady in our apartment.
She loves to play too, especially with a ball, but she's just as happy hanging out beside you afterward. She has this really nice balance of playful and laid-back.
Sky would be perfect for someone looking for a loving companion who truly bonds with their person. She's affectionate, loyal, gentle, and the kind of dog who very quickly starts to feel like she belongs right next to you.

I'm a sweet, loving girl who makes friends from the very first hello! When my human picked me up, I was ready for our adventure-no barking, no fuss! I hopped right into the car, relaxed in the back seat, and enjoyed a peaceful ride. Car rides? I've got those mastered!

Once we got home, I made myself comfortable right away! I explored, found my water bowl and cozy bed, and quickly discovered my favorite place: **right beside my human!** I'm a loyal little shadow who loves following you around and cuddling on the couch, but I'm also happy relaxing on my own bed when you're busy.

I'm an energetic girl who LOVES running, playing fetch, and showing off my athletic skills! Toss a ball or plush toy into the air, and watch me leap to catch it like a superstar! â­ I also love zooming around the backyard, sliding into the grass, rolling onto my back, and soaking up all the belly rubs!

I absolutely love nature walks! My human and I enjoyed hour-long adventures, and I still had energy to spare. I'm a great running buddy, love exploring new places, and enjoy meeting friendly people along the way.

But don't let my playful side fool you. I've got manners, too! ðŸ¥° I've patiently sat beside my human during outdoor meals without getting anxious or making a fuss.

I'm attentive, obedient, and love making eye contact with my human for guidance. Tell me a room is off-limits or that I can't sleep on the bed, and I'll respect your rules! I may still be learning a few commands, but I'm a quick learner who's eager to please.

You bring the love and a tennis ball or two, and I'll bring the cuddles, happy paws, and a lifetime of unforgettable memories!

Love, Sky

Meet Sky!

Sky lost her home when her owner could no longer care for her, and she's looking for a patient person who will help her feel safe and comfortable again. This sweet girl may take some time to warm up in new situations, but when she feels comfortable, she enjoys gentle affection and will happily lean in for cheek rubs. Sky is ready to find a home where she can relax, decompress, and be loved at her own pace.

My Ideal Home

Sky would do best with an experienced, patient adopter who understands canine body language and will give her the time and space she needs to build trust. A calm, predictable environment and positive, reward-based training will help Sky feel more confident as she adjusts to her new home.

Good with Other Pets?

Sky previously lived with another dog, but she has limited experience with unfamiliar dogs. She would benefit from slow, thoughtful introductions and should not visit dog parks at this time.

Good with Kids?

Sky would do best in an adult-only home where her boundaries can be respected and she can continue building confidence in a calm environment.

Things to Know

Sky is a medium-energy pup who enjoys walks and spending time with her people. She can be sensitive when it comes to handling and prefers to make the first move when meeting new friends. She also feels strongly about her favorite things, including food, treats, and toys, so her future family should use positive reinforcement and careful management around her special treasures. If you're looking for a loyal companion who will reward your patience with trust and affection, Sky may be your perfect match.

Sky was surrendered when her guardian had to leave the country, and she lived with adults, children and several other dogs in the home. A social butterfly, she is said to have been friendly and outgoing with visitors and tolerant of strangers. Her previous family described her as a social and affectionate dog, and we can 100% confirm that-she's always happy to get some scritches and regularly checks in with us on walks. Her family noted that she enjoyed spending most of her time around her people and that she especially loves car rides! At the care center, she's been militantly housebroken, and making the best she can of life in a crate located in a small overflow room.
dog.name: Sky
